bio.text: Doug Jones is the Democratic nominee for governor of Alabama in 2026, facing Republican Sen. Tommy Tuberville.
He served as a U.S. senator from Alabama from 2018 to 2021, after being elected in 2017, and lost re-election to Tuberville in 2020.
He is a lawyer who served as U.S. attorney for the Northern District of Alabama from 1997 to 2001.
